title: Aaron Donald's absence from Monday's practice "part of the plan all along"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Donald's absence from Monday's practice "part of the plan all along"
sources.description: Aaron Donald officially came out of retirement and practiced with the Rams on Sunday, but the three-time defensive player of the year was not on the field with the team on Monday.
